episode_title: Democrats' First 100 Hours, Outstanding Midterm Races, Trump Doubles Down On Policies
script_en: Democrats' First 100 Hours, Outstanding Midterm Races, Trump Doubles Down On Policies.

Democrats are preparing an ambitious opening agenda for their new congressional majority, including efforts to restore health subsidies, reverse Medicaid cuts, rein in tariffs and challenge the war with Iran.
Two Senate races remain undecided as Democrats continue gaining ground in places Republicans once considered safe, underscoring how dramatically the electorate shifted in the midterms.
President Trump says the war with Iran hurt Republicans at the polls but insists he would make the same decision again, even as he rejects the idea that the losses were a repudiation of him.
